# ADR-NNN: Decision title

Status: proposed / accepted / superseded

## Context

What concrete problem or constraint requires a decision?

## Options

Describe credible alternatives and their costs, including contributor setup and data/access implications.

## Decision

State the choice, scope, and responsible reviewer. Do not label a proposal accepted without the appropriate review.

## Consequences

What becomes easier, harder, or intentionally deferred? Identify migration and compatibility effects.

## Evidence

Link implementation, checks, and related issues. Identify assumptions needing verification.
